chunks.text:
Product Profile
Pooja is a high-yielding, late-maturing, semi-tall variety with long slender grains, extensively cultivated in Eastern India. Developed by NRRI, Cuttack, and released in 1999, it is highly adapted to lowland environments. Known for its good cooking quality, it exhibits tolerance to major diseases and insect pests, along with moderate HRR and good grain weight. Notably, it tolerates water stagnation up to 25 cm and is suitable for late transplanting with aged seedlings.

Key Strengths
- High yield
- Late maturity; Profuse tillering
- Strong straw strength
- Tolerant to lodging and shattering
- MS grain with good cooking & eating quality
- Photo sensitive variety
